zh.name: VIVIAN WANG
zh.role: 联合创始人 & 首席执行官（CEO）｜时尚总监
zh.bio:
作为 Vivian Adventure 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，Vivian Wang 同时担任品牌时尚总监，长期深耕中英及国际影视、时尚与商业影像领域。她统筹品牌整体美学战略与高端客户项目执行，以叙事力、审美力与商业化呈现能力构建品牌独有的视觉体系，推动公司在国际化合作中持续扩大影响力。

她在以下领域具备丰富的专业实践与商业合作经验：
• 英国电影、电视剧及国际影像项目的造型统筹与视觉指导
• 加拿大电影项目服化道全流程管理与落地执行
• Chaumet（尚美巴黎）高级珠宝活动、伦敦时装周秀场及明星红毯合作造型总监
• 电影制作、短剧、综艺、广告、商业大片、婚礼定制与高端品牌项目的整体风格设计与执行

凭借对国际时尚体系的深度理解与卓越的执行能力，Vivian Wang 为各类企业合作、品牌联合营销与跨领域创意项目提供专业、高标准的全流程审美与制作支持。

en.name: Vivian Wang
en.role: Co‑founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) | Fashion Director
en.bio:
As Co‑founder and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Vivian Adventure, Vivian Wang also serves as Fashion Director. She has long worked across UK–China and international film, fashion and commercial visual projects. Vivian oversees the studio’s aesthetic strategy and high‑end client delivery, building a distinctive visual language that fuses narrative, taste and commercial impact, and expanding the brand’s influence through global collaborations.

She brings extensive hands‑on and commercial experience in:
• Styling direction and visual supervision for UK films, TV series and international screen projects
• Full life‑cycle management and on‑set execution for costume, makeup and props in Canadian film productions
• Lead stylist for Chaumet high‑jewelry events, London Fashion Week runway shows and red‑carpet collaborations
• Overall visual design and execution for feature films, short dramas, variety shows, commercials, brand campaigns, wedding couture and high‑end brand projects

With deep understanding of global fashion systems and strong operational capability, Vivian provides high‑standard, end‑to‑end aesthetic and production support for corporate collaborations, co‑marketing initiatives and cross‑disciplinary creative projects.

zh.name: Ziming Wang
zh.role: 明星化妆造型师 ｜ 时尚造型导师 ｜ 美妆KOL
zh.bio:
王梓铭，资深化妆造型师，活跃于时尚、娱乐与新媒体领域，自2009年起从事明星艺人化妆与整体造型设计工作，是东田造型新生代签约造型师之一，同时担任东田造型学校高级讲师。

长期服务于影视艺人、音乐人及时尚品牌，擅长根据人物气质进行整体形象塑造与风格定位，涵盖舞台造型、时尚大片、商业拍摄及媒体视觉形象设计。其作品多次刊登于时尚杂志及主流新媒体平台。

专业经历

明星化妆造型师
东田造型签约造型师
东田造型学校高级讲师
美妆博主 / KOL

自2009年进入行业以来，持续为艺人、品牌与媒体提供专业造型服务，并参与大量商业视觉及时尚内容制作。

合作艺人（部分）

曾合作艺人及演艺团体包括（节选）：
宁静、李宇春、金莎、刘恋（Mr.Miss）、谢霆锋、陈伟霆、李希侃、庆怜、黄大炜、李泉、费玉清、赵传、沙宝亮、辛晓琪、苏有朋、罗言、鸽子Dove、诺曼德、永彬、徐子未、旅行新蜜蜂、光合少年、胡烨韬、玲羽、李昊瀚、黄雅莉、冯家妹、崔开潮、孙八一、LionBabe、肉食动物、杨九郎、潘长江等众多艺人

en.name: Ziming Wang
en.role: Celebrity Makeup Artist | Fashion Styling Instructor | Beauty KOL
en.bio:
Wang Ziming is a senior makeup artist and stylist active across fashion, entertainment and new media. Since 2009, he has worked on celebrity makeup and total look design. He is a new-generation signed stylist at Dongtian Styling and also serves as a senior lecturer at Dongtian Styling School.

He has long provided styling services for screen talents, musicians and fashion brands. Known for tailoring the overall image and style positioning to each client’s temperament, his work spans stage looks, fashion editorials, commercial shoots and media visual identities. His work has been featured in fashion magazines and major new-media platforms.

Professional Experience

• Celebrity makeup & styling
• Dongtian Styling signed stylist
• Senior lecturer, Dongtian Styling School
• Beauty creator / KOL

Selected Collaborations

Ning Jing, Chris Lee (Li Yuchun), Jin Sha, Liu Lian (Mr.Miss), Nicholas Tse, William Chan, Li Xikan, Qing Lian, Huang Dawei, Li Quan, Fei Yuqing, Zhao Chuan, Sha Baoliang, Xin Xiaoqi, Su Youpeng, Luo Yan, Dove, Normande, Yongbin, Xu Ziwei, Travel New Bees, Photosynthesis Youth, Hu Yetao, Ling Yu, Li Haohan, Huang Yali, Feng Jiamei, Cui Kaichao, Sun Bayi, LionBabe, Carnivores, Yang Jiulang, Pan Changjiang, and more.

zh.name: 包铭涵 博士
zh.role: 联合创始人 & 首席技术官（CTO）｜英国人工智能博士 & 英国皇家工程院 GTV 全球人才获得者
zh.bio:
包铭涵博士（英国人工智能博士、英国皇家工程院 GTV 全球人才获得者）负责 Vivian Adventure 的整体技术战略，主导公司 AI 系统搭建、数字平台开发，以及智慧化内容生产流程。

他在以下方面推动公司核心能力升级：
• 企业级商业合作与项目赋能
• 科技融入的创意内容与策展项目
• 品牌创新与数字化转型
• 各类大型活动、展会、合作项目的技术统筹。 凭借扎实的人工智能与计算机技术实力，他推动 Vivian Adventure 完成数字化升级，在科技&时尚传媒，企业合作、品牌共创与跨领域商业项目中不断提升公司的执行力与行业影响力。

en.name: Dr. Minghan Bao
en.role: Co‑founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | UK PhD in AI & Royal Academy of Engineering GTV Global Talent recipient
en.bio:
Dr. Minghan Bao, a UK PhD in Artificial Intelligence and Royal Academy of Engineering GTV Global Talent recipient, serves as Co‑founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at Vivian Adventure. He leads the company’s technology strategy, including AI system architecture, digital platform development and intelligent content‑production workflows.

Minghan advances the studio’s core capabilities in:
• Enterprise‑level collaborations and project enablement
• Tech‑integrated creative content and curatorial projects
• Brand innovation and digital transformation
• Technical direction for large‑scale events, exhibitions and partnership programmes

With a solid background in AI and computer science, he drives Vivian Adventure’s digital transformation across fashion and media, corporate partnerships, brand co‑creation and cross‑sector commercial initiatives, continually raising the studio’s operational excellence and industry profile.

zh.name: Dr. Patrick Lenihan
zh.role: 英国计算机科学博士｜AI系统与机器学习优化专家
zh.bio: Lenihan博士为英国计算机科学博士，人工智能系统与机器学习优化领域专家，长期致力于将前沿 AI 技术应用于数字内容生产、智能系统开发与跨国技术协作，他在人工智能工程与产业实践方面拥有丰富经验，曾参与华为 “Seeds for the Future” 国际人才项目，接受 5G 网络架构、云计算与人工智能技术国际技术交流与创新合作项目，具备跨文化科技合作与全球化项目沟通经验。在 Vivian Adventure 团队中，Patrick 主要负责推动 AI 技术与影视创意制作的融合应用，探索人工智能在影像生成、内容优化与数字创意生产流程中的创新实践，同时参与跨国企业合作策划与技术解决方案设计，支持中英之间在科技、文化与创意产业领域的深度协作。Patrick 致力于通过 AI 技术连接科技与艺术，推动跨国创意产业的数字化升级与全球合作发展。

en.name: Dr. Patrick Lenihan
en.role: UK PhD in Computer Science | AI Systems & ML Optimization
en.bio:
Dr. Lenihan holds a UK PhD in Computer Science and specializes in AI systems and machine-learning optimization. He focuses on applying frontier AI technologies to digital content production, intelligent system development and cross-border technical collaboration. He previously participated in Huawei’s “Seeds for the Future” global talent programme, engaging in international exchanges around 5G network architecture, cloud computing and AI.

At Vivian Adventure, Patrick drives the integration of AI with film and creative production, exploring innovation in image generation, content optimization and digital creative workflows. He also supports cross-border corporate collaboration planning and technical solution design, enabling deeper UK–China cooperation across technology, culture and the creative industries.

zh.name: Hao
zh.bio:
专注时尚与艺人肖像光影塑造，注重层次与质感的稳定输出。
流程：前期面部/材质观察 → 光比规划 → 现场微调与回看。
风格：稳健光比、克制修饰、定制化方案。

en.name: Hao
en.bio:
Fashion & artist portrait light shaping with consistent tonal depth.
Workflow: facial/material scan → ratio plan → live micro‑adjust & review.
Style: controlled ratios, restrained retouch, tailored planning.

zh.name: Jade
zh.bio:
电影与时尚影像创作，擅长情绪光影与人物表达。
特点：叙事张力、镜头节奏感、技术与美学平衡。

en.name: Jade
en.bio:
Film & fashion visual creator; strong at mood lighting and character expression.
Traits: narrative tension, rhythmic framing, craft–aesthetic balance.

zh.name: Patrick Xue
zh.role: 摄影师｜影像艺术创作者
zh.bio:
结合传统与实验媒介，探索材质与情绪的影像表达。
擅长：胶片/即时成像、叙事型 MV、材质肌理营造。

en.name: Patrick Xue
en.bio:
Blends traditional & experimental media to explore texture and mood.
Strengths: film & instant formats, narrative MV, material tactility.

zh.name: Kris
zh.bio:
以富士色彩与自然光构建呼吸感人像氛围。
擅长：自然街拍、克制细节、色温渐变。

en.name: Kris
en.bio:
Uses Fujifilm color & natural light for airy, restrained portraits.
Strengths: candid urban sessions, subtle detail, gentle temperature shifts.

zh.name: Fu
zh.bio:
专注色彩与情绪的平衡，塑造带时间质感的光影。
特点：留白控制、光影层次、真实情绪捕捉。

en.name: Fu
en.bio:
Balances color & emotion, shaping time‑layered light.
Traits: managed negative space, layered illumination, authentic mood capture.

zh.name: Lori
zh.role: 化妆师｜造型与发型设计
zh.bio:
擅长韩妆体系与亚裔五官优化，注重提高面部骨相与比例关系。
定制化妆发方案：依据肤质与场景匹配底妆质地与发型结构；整体风格克制清爽、细节干净，审美统一。
适用：婚礼、时尚拍摄、商务形象。

en.name: Lori
en.bio:
Specialized in Korean‑inspired makeup for Asian faces, enhancing facial structure and proportions.
Customized makeup & hair plans matched to skin type and setting; clean, restrained finish with consistent aesthetics.
Suited for bridal, fashion shoots and business portraits.

zh.name: Johnny
zh.bio:
定制化男士发型与妆容，包含裸妆与上镜自然妆效，适用于商务、人像、活动等多场景。
根据骨骼与发流做自然过渡与轮廓修整；同时长期服务于艺人/明星造型。

en.name: Johnny
en.bio:
Customized men's hair and grooming, including natural/no‑makeup camera‑ready looks for business, portrait and event scenarios.
Aligns style to facial structure and hair flow; works as a celebrity stylist.

zh.name: Ivy
zh.role: 摄影与妆造助理｜客户与档期协调
zh.bio:
摄影方面擅长氛围感塑造，熟悉 Canon 系统与高清人像拍摄；依据人物特征安排合适光影并打造不同风格（清透、质感、纪实等）。
现场与幕后管理：跟进镜头顺序与补光设备、基础补妆与耗材补给、节奏与沟通维护；整理客户反馈以便后续优化。

en.name: Ivy
en.role: Photo & Styling Assistant | Client & Scheduling Coordinator
en.bio:
Strong at atmospheric photography; experienced with Canon systems and high‑definition portraits. Crafts light and shadow to suit each subject and can deliver varied styles (clean, textured, documentary).
On‑set & back‑of‑house: tracks shot order & lighting hand‑offs, light touch‑ups and consumables, pacing & comms; maintains client feedback for follow‑ups.
